headline: Verified Saudi escalation lifts weekend Stress while Tail stays low without live NQ structure
body: NQ futures are closed, so current directional efficiency, pullback depth and failed retracements cannot be observed. Reuters reports Houthi claims of missile and drone attacks on Riyadh sites and an Aramco facility in Yanbu, while damage to Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remains an energy-supply risk. Friday's Nasdaq gain was semiconductor-led despite negative breadth, with Treasury yields above 5% and crude above $100. These conditions raise reopening-gap and volatility risk but do not establish a persistent NQ Tail path.

outlookSummary: The next 24 hours remain inside the weekend NQ closure. Tail is expected to stay in the low band unless new verified geopolitical discontinuities materially change the information set; Stress remains high to extreme because Saudi security and pipeline risks can affect the eventual reopening gap. The Sunday futures reopening occurs after this forecast horizon.
